battle_royale_mechanic_changes.gloo_wall_makers: Capacity increases by 1 per Gloo Maker level; Gloo Walls from eliminations and loot boxes unified to 1

coin_machines_and_loot.med_kits: Removed from Coin Machines; increased ground drops

battle_royale_mechanic_changes.vending_machine_interaction: Optimized to prevent damage interrupts from cancelling interactions easily

global_movement_speed_cap.description: Hard cap applied on maximum movement speed from skills, items, and buffs, displaying special visual effect when hit

combat_and_physics_engine.aim_assist_priority: Prioritizes standing enemies over downed enemies when overlapping

wall_penetration_indicators.effects: Leaves penetration marks on Gloo Walls; crosshair dynamically changes when aiming through Gloo Walls

combat_and_physics_engine.damage_ui: Scaling damage numbers introduced (higher damage numbers appear larger)
combat_and_physics_engine.self_revive_assist: Teammates can interact with self-reviving players to speed up revival time
combat_and_physics_engine.debuff_indicators: Visual indicators added for Slow, Healing Reduction, and Vest/Helmet break states

ui_controls_and_hud.movement_wheel_setting: Added 'Fixed' option so wheel stays stationary and doesn't follow left hand

looting_and_inventory.auto_swap_logic: Automatically equips enhanced versions of ground weapons over currently held weapons
looting_and_inventory.auto_pickup_ammo: Automatically collects ammo stacks up to configured cap

ui_controls_and_hud.area_capture_indicators: Enhanced capture alerts for Revival Points, Defense Airdrops, Ultra Airdrops, and Cyber Airdrops when enemies enter zone
ui_controls_and_hud.weapon_attribute_display: Added visual stat breakdowns in Backpack, Training Grounds, and CS Store UI

features: Key events timeline (Fights, Revivals, Arsenal Captures)

room_spectating_improvements.nearby_info_panel: Shows team count in range; tapping switches perspective directly
room_spectating_improvements.map_icon_switching: Tap team icons on map to switch spectating target
room_spectating_improvements.inventory_visibility: Spectators can view spectated player's healing items
